He had first served as aide in Hedong; on business he reached the capital and lodged at a relay station.
He had first served as aide in Hezhong; on business he reached the capital and lodged at a relay station.
Focus unit reads 河中從事; 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東). The proposed place-name correction is exact.
Yisun had first been an aide in Hedong; on business he went to the capital and lodged at a relay station.
Yisun had first been an aide in Hezhong; on business he went to the capital and lodged at a relay station.
Literal likewise mistranslates 河中 as Hedong; Hezhong restores the correct circuit name.
Ning said, "Such men covet others' goods before the fact; when crisis comes they fall short.
Ning said, "By my estimate, one must seize the initiative before the other does; when the crisis arrives it is already too late.

凝曰「以臣料之，先人有奪人之心，臨事即不及也」 uses the classical maxim of seizing initiative first; the original 'covet others' goods' misreads 奪人之心, and the proposed rendering matches the maxim and the following plan to prepare blank edicts in advance.

Fan, privy council academician, grand master, vice minister of works, supreme pillar, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households, gold-purple fish tally—once aided the late emperor with full counsel; serving me, his loyalty bends further; in service he has a great minister's form, in conduct a gentleman's learning.

Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor with every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving his superiors he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.

Chinese 樞密院直學士…奉上得大臣之體，檢身為君子之儒 requires Direct Academician and the 奉上/檢身 contrast; the before flattens those into vague 'in service'/'in conduct' and omits 直 and 眇躬. The proposed fuller idiomatic restores those senses without inventing content.

Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works in the Ministry of Revenue, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households' fief, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor, every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving the above he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.

Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works in the Ministry of Works, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households' fief, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor, every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving the above he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.
尚書工部侍郎 is Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works (工部), not Revenue (戶部). Replacing Revenue with Works corrects the office name.
